# Production Data

> Production Data allows users to export Excel production reports from Final Cut Pro timelines.

- [Frequently Asked Questions](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/faq.md): Yes. The exported .xlsx workbook follows the standard Excel file format, so it opens directly in Apple's Numbers, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and other spreadsheet applications that support .xlsx files, without requiring any conversion.

## Case Study

- [Final Cut Pro's Enigma](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/case-study/final-cut-pro-enigma.md): Final Cut Pro stands out as a radically different NLE primarily because of its exclusive optimisation for the macOS ecosystem, leveraging seamless integration with Apple hardware and software.
- [Reviving A Lost Feature](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/case-study/reviving-a-lost-feature.md): Those of us who have been in the industry long enough would recall Legacy Final Cut Pro 7. It was a professional video editing software developed by Apple. Final Cut Pro 7 was highly popular and widely used in the film and television industry for its advanced features and powerful tools.
- [Alternative Report Generator](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/case-study/alternative-report-generator.md): Production's Best Friend is, by a wide margin, the most established and widely trusted tool for generating professional reports from Final Cut Pro projects, developed by Intelligent Assistance.

## User Guide

- [Overview](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/overview.md): Production Data has been meticulously crafted with a focus on simplicity, ensuring that users can execute tasks with minimal interaction. A central objective in its development has been reducing the number of clicks required for a seamless experience.
- [Extract](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/extract.md): Extract Window
- [General Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/general.md): General Settings
- [Roles](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/roles.md): Roles Settings
- [Configuration Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/configurations.md): Configuration Settings
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/keyboard-shortcuts.md): You can use keyboard shortcuts to quickly accomplish Common tasks in Production Data. To use a keyboard shortcut, press all the keys in the shortcut at the same time.
